amap.name: 高德 Web Service API
amap.usage_rights: API terms; keep research evidence locally, check redistribution rights separately
amap.authority_note: Routing times and fares are provider estimates, not real arrival guarantees. Weather reporttime governs source freshness; its upstream independence from CMA is unverified, so it does not add a second independent weather-source group. Amap need not be authoritative for venue temporary closure, inventory or accessibility.

nmc.name: 中央气象台城市天气页面
nmc.authority_note: Concrete applicable dated bulletin needed. Page date fragments without year/timezone remain unknown. Not independent from other CMA service mirrors.

weather_com_cn.name: 中国天气网
weather_com_cn.authority_note: Same institutional weather-service lineage as NMC; do not count two websites as two independent forecasts. Verify issue time on actual page.

cma_portal.name: 中国气象局公共门户
cma_portal.authority_note: Only a concrete applicable bulletin with issue time is evidence; homepage alone is not. Verify upstream provenance: a republication of the same feed is not an independent observation.

shanghai_metro.name: 上海地铁运营公告
shanghai_metro.authority_note: Applicable dated operator notice needed. Does not substitute for the required Amap door-to-door route-duration call.
